visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with longish brown hair wearing a bright orange hoodie with a blue graphic logo stands on a blue and yellow metal outdoor exercise machine. He gestures with his hands towards the camera, smiling with high energy. The background shows an urban park with trees and tall residential buildings under bright natural daylight. A digital confetti overlay appears briefly. (2) The man is at a breakfast stall on Day 1. He interacts with a male vendor wearing a black shirt and a face mask. Close-up shots show a box of Teppanyaki noodles with two sunny-side-up eggs. He uses wooden chopsticks to poke the egg yolks and picks up noodles. A white OATSIDE oat milk carton sits on the table. (3) The scene transitions to a car interior where the man sits in the front and hands a carton of OATSIDE to an older woman with grey hair in the back seat. She holds the carton with both hands and looks at it curiously. Later, a girl in a pink hoodie is seen in a 7-11 store holding the product near refrigerated shelves. (4) Multiple quick scenes show the man at various outdoor food stalls for Days 3-7. He eats turnip cakes, spicy chicken rice, and braised pork rice while drinking different flavors of OATSIDE. He uses expressive facial movements, squinting his eyes and smiling to show his reaction to the food combinations. Friends and vendors are visible in the background. (5) The man stands in a brightly lit indoor studio with a white wall and office furniture. He wears a grey jacket over a blue t-shirt and holds the OATSIDE carton prominently. He takes a long drink through a straw, closing his eyes, and then looks at the camera with an exaggerated look of amazement. The video ends with a close-up of his smiling face.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator, his mother, two female friends (Pinpin and girl in pink), two stall vendors, and approximately three background customers.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with longish, wavy brown hair, wearing a vibrant orange hoodie in earlier scenes and a grey jacket with an orange lining in later scenes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves through various urban Taiwanese settings including a public park, several traditional street-side breakfast stalls with metal roofs and round tables, the interior of a car, a brightly lit 7-11 convenience store, and a clean white office/studio space.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a loud, energetic greeting from a male speaker with a bright, high-pitched voice. High-tempo electronic BGM kicks in immediately with a strong rhythmic beat. A sharp 'pop' SFX accompanies the visual confetti, followed by light ambient outdoor chatter that is mostly masked by the music. (2) A transition marked by a fast 'whoosh' SFX leads into Day 1. The male voice becomes slightly more conversational as he orders food, though still projecting loudly. Sounds of plastic rustling and a distinct 'click' from a straw being poked through a carton are audible. The music maintains its steady, upbeat tempo. (3) Slurping sounds are frequent as the narrator eats noodles. A comedic 'boing' SFX plays during a joke. When his mother speaks in the car, her voice is lower in volume and has a gentler, more natural tone compared to the narrator's high-arousal delivery. Ambient car interior hum is barely perceptible. (4) In the 7-11 segment, a retail store 'ding' SFX is heard. The music swells in volume during shots of the product on the shelf. The female voice in the store has a mid-range pitch and sounds slightly shy or amused, followed by an inserted laugh track SFX. (5) The final studio segment features very clean, professional audio with no ambient noise. The narrator's voice is focused and enunciated. A long, exaggerated swallowing sound and a satisfied vocal exhale ('Ah!') are highlighted. The BGM reaches a crescendo before a sharp hard cut at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence (7 Days of Pairing) -> Personal Testimony -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog and product endorsement for OATSIDE oat milk. The creator uses a '7-day challenge' format to test how well the oat milk pairs with various traditional Taiwanese breakfasts. By showing his genuine (and sometimes humorous) reactions to the pairings, he builds authenticity and encourages viewers to purchase the product at 7-11.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, verbal naming of the brand, filming inside a partner retail store (7-11), and a clear call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends high-production value with a casual, social-media native editing style. The use of the creator's mother and friends adds a relatable, communal feel to the advertisement.
